title: Ledger replaced event
description: A `reset` event whose `data` is JSON `{ seq }`: the ledger file was replaced (a git pull, a sync, a copy dropped in), not only appended to, and the server read it again from the start. A client reads the whole ledger again.

data.description: JSON text `{ "seq": <ledger position> }`: the position of the ledger as read again, which may be lower than before.

retry.description: How many milliseconds a client waits before it reconnects.
